title: The Friend at Midnight
reflectionText: The friend does not get up out of tenderness; he gets up because the knocking will not stop. Jesus turns that toward prayer — ask, seek, knock — and then past it: if flawed human fathers still hand their children bread and not stones, how much more will the Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask. The promise is not that every request is granted; it is that the Father gives himself. What have you stopped asking for?
